journeys.title: New York City

stops.name: Central Park Zoo
stops.back: Tucked inside Central Park, the zoo is a favorite stop for families and first walks alike.
stops.coachLine: Your very first stop. Here's to many more.

stops.name: Bethesda Fountain
stops.back: The fountain sits by the lake in the middle of the park, with a wide terrace for resting and people-watching.
stops.coachLine: A lovely place to catch your breath.

stops.name: Times Square
stops.back: Bright screens, busy sidewalks and theaters all around. It's one of the most famous crossroads in the world.
stops.coachLine: Look how far those minutes have carried you.

stops.name: Bryant Park
stops.back: A leafy park in Midtown, with a lawn, green chairs and a quiet library next door.
stops.coachLine: A calm spot in the middle of it all.

stops.name: Union Square
stops.back: A lively square with a farmers market on many days of the week.
stops.coachLine: Almost at the river. Keep going.

stops.name: Brooklyn Bridge
stops.back: The bridge crosses the East River to Brooklyn, with a wide walkway above the traffic.
stops.coachLine: You walked all of New York. I'm so proud of you.

journeys.subtitle: Central Park to Brooklyn Bridge
journeys.summary: From the zoo in Central Park, through Times Square, all the way to the Brooklyn Bridge. About 2–3 weeks.

journeys.title: Smoky Mountains and the Blue Ridge Parkway
journeys.summary: Quiet valleys, waterfalls and mountain views, from Cades Cove to the Linn Cove Viaduct. About 4–6 weeks.

journeys.title: The Camino de Santiago
journeys.subtitle: the last 100 km
journeys.summary: Stone villages and green hills of Galicia, from Sarria to the great square in Santiago. About 4–6 weeks.

journeys.title: New England lighthouses
journeys.subtitle: Maine to Cape Cod
journeys.summary: Rocky coastline and white lighthouses, from Portland Head Light to Nauset Light. About 4–6 weeks.

journeys.title: Pacific Coast Highway
journeys.subtitle: Big Sur
journeys.summary: Cliffs, beaches and ocean views, from Carmel-by-the-Sea past Bixby Bridge. About 4–6 weeks.
